Dynamic Extra Encounters Level Scaling Bonus
The veil is thin, and the innocent do not forget. A vengeful presence is tethered to your soul, waiting for the right moment to claim its due. You are not alone.

You carry a stolen artifact of Avernus. The demonic energy surging through you grants you a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag>, but the beacon it creates draws the ire of Cambions and Devils.

Your reflexes are heightened by the surrounding gloom, granting a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag>. Unfortunately, this concentrated darkness is a magnet for the Lady of Loss, attracting violent Shadows and spectral Dark Justiciars.

The raw, unfiltered life force pumping from this organ fortifies your blood, granting a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag>. However, the scent of this stolen magic attracts bloodthirsty Redcaps and rotting Wood Woads.
A massive, bloodshot eye suspended in a murky, foul-smelling fluid. Local tribes revere it as a holy artifact of their fierce god of war, though its true biological origin remains a gruesome mystery.

A jagged, luminescent crystal shard that refracts light in impossible, dizzying ways. Gazing into it reveals a slightly idealized, endlessly smiling reflection of yourself that moves just a fraction of a second after you do.

A heavy tome bound in dark metal, its cover resembling a wrought-iron gate holding back a swirling vortex of hellfire. The pages are uncomfortably warm to the touch and constantly smell of brimstone and burnt copper.

A remarkably intact brain floating within a sophisticated, spiky glass vessel filled with glowing green preservative fluid. It pulses faintly with raw psychic energy, occasionally sending a dull ache into the temples of anyone holding it.

The mental resonance of this vessel expands your mind, granting a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag>. The terrible cost is that it broadcasts your location across the psionic network, alerting Intellect Devourers and Mind Flayers.

The piercing insight of this macabre trophy grants a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag>. However, possessing it makes you a prime target for frenzied Goblins and their Worgs.

The unnatural confidence radiating from the crystal grants a permanent +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag>. Beware the crystal, as the magic occasionally shatters reality to spawn hostile, shadowy duplicates of you and your allies who wish to replace the originals.
A hardened, fist-sized mass that still beats faintly against your palm. It smells intensely of swamp water and rot, radiating a foul but incredibly potent vitality.
A heavy, cold sphere of dark stone marbled with faint, glowing cyan veins. It seems to absorb the light immediately around it, leaving a permanent, unnatural gloom inside your pack.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="TutorialRedWarning"/> This item is cursed! Beware of picking it up!
Shower nearby creatures in morphic brine that deals damage and coats surfaces.
When the intellect glutton dies, it bursts in a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_DEE_DeathBurst_IntellectDetonator">Morphic Brine Explosion</LSTag>.
This Toggles the Scavengers on or off. (Dynamic Extra Encounters).
Allows you to Enable or Disable Dynamic Extra Encounters Features.
Allows you to enable or disable Dynamic Extra Encounters features.
Stops the Buried Undead from Spawning when you dig up buried chests.
Stops the Vengeful Spirit from Spawning.
Stops the Githyanki Hunters from Spawning after using your Illithid Powers.
This Toggles the undead on or off when digging up buried chests. (Dynamic Extra Encounters).
This Toggles the Elementals on or off when specific elemental damage is dealt. (Dynamic Extra Encounters).
This Toggles the Githyanki Hunters on or off when you use you Illithid Powers. (Dynamic Extra Encounters).
This Toggles the Vengeful Spirits on or off when killing civilians. (Dynamic Extra Encounters).
Enable or Disable Marked by the Departed
Enable or Disable Hunted by the Githyanki
Spell container for enabling or disabling features.

By killing the infiltrators at the Grove, you have drawn the attention of the many Shadow Druids still active in the wilds. They will follow your trail relentlessly until you reach the Shadow-Cursed Lands, a place far too dark even for those who walk the shadows.
Dynamic Extra Encounters Shadow Druid Trigger
Stops the Shadow Druids from Spawning.
Enable or Disable Shadow Druid Ambushes
Traders view this piece with deep suspicion, raising prices out of instinct. Yet, its true purpose reveals it as a token of high prestige, eventually currying great favor.

A persistent and disturbing aura twists the perceptions of those around you. Merchants recoil from your presence and demand significantly higher prices for their goods. This distortion is reversed once the curse is lifted, causing vendors to view you as a highly favored patron and offer a slight discount instead.
Stops the Camp Ogres from Spawning after Long Resting.
Stops the Animated Armor from Spawning when looting chest pieces.
Stops the Thieves from Spawning when Lockpicking.
Stops enemies from going on a Vendetta against the player.

Fueled by the bitter memory of your near-death, your hatred pushes you past your natural limits.

Vendetta Threat: Normal

What did not kill you has only sharpened your blade. You have meticulously studied your prey, returning with lethal precision and adaptive countermeasures.

Vendetta Threat: Elite

Through sheer force of will, you have transcended mortal frailty to become an unstoppable embodiment of revenge. You will not rest until your target is utterly destroyed.

Vendetta Threat: Miniboss
Gain a +[1] to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> as long as you remain above [2]% <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.
Gain +[1] of <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> and become immune to <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag>.
Regain [1] at the start of each turn.
All melee attacks against you are reduced by [1].
Reduce the number needed to roll a Critical Hit by [1].
Grants <LSTag Tooltip="Resistance">Resistance</LSTag> to Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning damage. This resistance is temporarily broken for [1] turn if they are hit by Fire, Cold, or Acid damage.
Once per turn, you have a [1]% chance to apply <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEE_VENDETTA_ELITE_03_MIASMA">Maddening Miasma</LSTag> for [2] turns.
You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against Spells, and spells that deal damage have their damage reduced by [1].
When struck by a melee attack, your blood burns the attacker, dealing [1].

Granted immunity to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PARALYZED">Paralyze</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DOMINATE_PERSON">Dominated</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunned</LSTag> conditions.
You deal an additional [1] damage, and heal for [2]% of the damage dealt. (Once per attack).
A shroud of vindictive magic protects you. Whenever you take damage, the attacker takes[1] equal to [2]% of the damage dealt.
You gain <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag> equal to half your total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag>.

You gain an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action Point</LSTag> and your <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">Opportunity Attacks</LSTag> have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
Recently taken Fire, Cold, or Acid damage. While you have this status, you no longer have the benefits of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEE_VENDETTA_ELITE_02">Adaptive Carapace</LSTag>.
Deal damage back to melee attackers.
Hostile to everyone and take [1] at the end of your turn.
Explode a corpse, causing it to impale those around it.
Ring the bell of impending doom. If the target is at full health, you deal [1] instead.

Cannot regain hit points. Cannot help Downed characters.

If Undead, has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.
Let out a bone-chilling howl that <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MOO_MAG_KETHERIC_STUPEFIED">Numbs</LSTag> all nearby creatures.
Command an ally in the Dark Lord's name, letting them channel <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DEE_NPC_BanesWrath">Bane's Wrath</LSTag>.
Strike with the Black Hand's ire, dealing more damage and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightening</LSTag> your target.
This creature can channel <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_BanesWrath">Bane's Wrath</LSTag> - it is the Black Hand's will.
The vampire regains [1] at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken[2] or damage from holy water, in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn.
Stops enemies from spawning based on your companions background story.
Enable or Disable Companion Story Based Enemies
Your master has not forgotten you. Your fellow spawns have caught your scent, and they are coming to drag you back to the dark.
By turning away from the darkness, you have painted a target on your back. Devout followers of the Lady of Loss are relentlessly tracking you to punish your betrayal.
The volatile magic leaking from your chest is acting as a beacon. Creatures starved for magic are drawn directly to the orb, eager to feed on it's magic.
The intense, uncontained heat radiating from your infernal engine is attracting beings of intense heat to your location.
Your true lineage has been exposed, making you a high-value target for ruthless cultists aiming to manipulate the city's political future.
Traveling with istik has branded you a vulnerability. Overzealous warriors of your own kind seek to prove themselves by violently purging you from their ranks.
Checks if you have used an illithid power from the Illithid Powers Overhaul Mod.
The clone will copy the spells this character casts.
Tracks if a clone used a spell.
When the entity it mimics casts a spell, this clone shimmers and instantly learns the spell for itself.
Though simple and weatherworn, this chest seems sturdy enough.

This NPC has fled the battle to plot its revenge against you.

When you change Acts, this NPC will lose your trail and no longer try to ambush you.
Shadow Druids are tracking you, when this status gets removed, the Shadow Druids will ambush you!
Applied so the Roots of Shadow doesn't continue to activate, gets reset on short rest.
When this applies, Osiris catches it which starts the timer.

Open the configuration panel for Dynamic Encounters Expanded.
Kobold scavengers have a chance of arriving 10 minutes after each combat encounter to loot the remains of whats left on the battlefield.
Digging up buried chests has a chance to disturb the dead.
Unleashing magic draws the attention of the elemental planes. Dealing enough of a specific elemental damage type in a single turn has a chance to spawn an elemental of the corresponding element.
Murder has consequences. Killing civilians has a chance for them to become vengeful spirits. These spirits will bide their time and ambush you soon after.
Every time you tap into your Illithid Powers, there is a chance that a Githyanki hunting party will sense the psionic ripple and warp in to eliminate your party.
Slaying the three infiltrating Shadow Druids in the Druid Grove draws the attention of the other Shadow Druids still active in the Wilderness.
Upon completing a Long Rest, there is a chance that the scent of your feast attracts a Hungry Ogre to your camp.
Some discarded relics refuse to be worn by the unworthy. Equipping an untested piece of metal chest armor now carries a chance to awaken dormant magic in the armor.
Some locks aren't just meant to keep you out—they are bait. Successfully picking a lock now carries a chance to spring a hidden trap, summoning an opportunistic thief.

Whenever an enemy drops below 20% health, there is a chance they will flee the battlefield to plot revenge. These escaped enemies will begin stalking your party, with escalating chances to ambush you in future combat encounters.

Traveling with allies means sharing their burdens. Depending on who is actively in your party and what events have unfolded during your journey, unique threats tied directly to their current circumstances will occasionally track your group down.
Let out a howl, which has a chance to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frighten</LSTag> enemies within [1].
Leap at a single creature dealing [1] and potentially knocking the target Prone on a failed Strength Saving Throw.
While Lord Fluffington is alive, you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Wisdom and Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Reduces Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage by [1].
When Lord Fluffington dies, Sir Hugglesworth gains <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEE_BUGBEAR_BLOODLUST">Bloodlust</LSTag>.
When Sir Hugglesworth dies, Lord Fluffington gains <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DEE_BUGBEAR_WORG_GRIEF">Grieving Frenzy</LSTag>.

Lord Fluffington has died, you enter a state of Bloodlust granting you an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action Point</LSTag> but your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> is reduced by [1].
Sir Hugglesworth has died, you become Frenzied, All <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> and you deal an additional [1] Damage.
While Lord Fluffington is alive, you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Wisdom and Charisma <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Grant Lord Fluffington a +[1] bonus on all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and +[2] of <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag>.
Sir Hugglesworth has given you a command! You have a +[1] bonus on all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, and +[2] of <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag>.

Immune to being Enwebbed. Your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> is not affected by web surfaces and while standing on a web surface you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.
Despawns enemies from Occupied Lands (New Overworld Encounters).
Populates the map with new fixed encounters, patrols, and minibosses.
When the time runs out, the barrel detonates dealing [1] in a [2] radius.
Your feet smell so bad, they emit a pungent cloud that <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STINKING_CLOUD">Nauseates</LSTag> all creatures around you.
Regains [1] whenever ending a turn inside a Alcohol surface.
When you take damage from a melee attack, it applies [1] turns of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Drunk</LSTag> and creates a [2] alcohol surface.
Regain [1] if you end your turn in alcohol.

You have [1] <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag>, and while you have these <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag>, you can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>.
